title: De'Longhi kettle £39.99, Braun Series 5 £54.99 and a Bartesian for £199
description: Thursday's checked UK deals: De'Longhi coffee kit from £29.99 at Argos, a Braun Series 5 shaver for £54.99, Boots gift sets from £4.50 and a £199 Bartesian.
intro:
**Today's best buys are in the kitchen: Argos has cut three De'Longhi breakfast basics, with the Brilliante kettle down to £39.99, a filter coffee machine at £29.99 and a burr grinder at £39.99.** Boots also has some cheap Christmas gift sets, starting at £4.50, and Currys has £100 off the Bartesian cocktail maker.

It's a shorter list of eight today. Several retailer and deal sites blocked our checks this morning, so these prices come from T3's early Black Friday live blog and MoneyMagpie's Black Friday roundup, both updated yesterday (4 November). Check the price at the till. Buy now or wait? The De'Longhi pieces and the Boots gift sets are good prices to buy now. The Fold 8 and the Bartesian are big-ticket items that could still dip before Black Friday on 27 November.

deals.name: De'Longhi Brilliante KBJ3001 kettle
deals.note: 38% off a smart, well-made kettle with a metallic finish that looks far pricier than it is. A good pick if you're refreshing the kitchen or need a housewarming present.

deals.name: De'Longhi ICM15210 filter coffee machine
deals.note: A simple drip machine for people who want a jug of proper coffee without bean-to-cup prices. If you want espresso instead, our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices.

deals.name: De'Longhi KG79 coffee grinder
deals.note: A burr grinder with adjustable coarseness, so it suits filter, cafetière and moka pots. Freshly ground beans make the biggest difference to cheap coffee kit, so pair it with the machine above.

deals.name: L'Oréal Paris Men Expert Alive & Kicking gift set
deals.note: Half price, and a safe men's grooming present for a colleague, teenager or Secret Santa. See our [Secret Santa gifts under £10](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/) for cheaper ideas.

deals.name: The White Collection Pomegranate Hand Duo
deals.note: A hand wash and lotion pair for under a fiver. It's an easy stocking filler or teacher's present, and the kind of gift set that sells out in December.

deals.name: Braun Series 5 52-A1000s electric shaver
deals.note: A dependable wet-and-dry foil shaver at a sensible price. The £135.99 'was' is a list price that few people pay, so ignore the size of the saving, but under £55 is still good for a Series 5.

deals.name: Bartesian cocktail maker, grey
deals.note: £100 off a capsule cocktail machine that makes a fun Christmas centrepiece. Remember the capsules add up, and gadgets like this often get a further cut on Black Friday, so wait unless you need it soon. Our [Currys Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/currys-black-friday-2026/) covers when Currys' sale peaks.

deals.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 256GB, Lavender
deals.note: £400 off Samsung's flagship foldable, bought outright and SIM-free. That's a big cut this early, but only worth it if you'll actually use the tablet-sized inner screen.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not for the De'Longhi kettle or the Boots gift sets. They're already around half price, and cheap gift sets tend to sell out rather than get cheaper. The Bartesian and the Fold 8 are the ones to think about. Both are expensive, and Black Friday on 27 November could bring a little more off. See [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for every retailer's dates, and our [Argos Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/) for what Argos usually cuts.

## This week: Christmas beauty gift sets

Today's two Boots sets fit this week's spotlight, [Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/), which has target prices and the Boots offers worth knowing about. Our [Boots Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/boots-black-friday-2026/) explains when Boots' biggest beauty discounts usually land.
